task_description:
Analyze the entire epic-ai repository and produce a concise internal map of:
- Apps and packages (purpose of each)
- How the system is started locally on Windows
- Required environment variables and services
- Which apps are production-critical vs experimental

Validate that the project can be installed and run locally:
- pnpm install
- docker-compose services if required
- identify the correct dev/start commands

Fix only what is required to make local dev parity work.
Do not refactor or add features yet.
Produce a short summary and readiness checklist.
